The '''Omwat system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Garis sector/Legends|Garis sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Omwat/Legends|Omwat]], the [[Omwati/Legends|Omwati's]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. It was located near the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]].
